people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.
translations.bsb: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
translations.kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
translations.asv: And David said to Solomon his son, As for me, it was in my heart to build a house unto the name of Jehovah my God.
